terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Scaled Neutron service margin after production/cadence normalization.

factor_correlations_meta.rationale: Aerospace demand and economics co-move, but technical milestone outcomes retain large idiosyncratic risk.

default_loading_meta.rationale: Lower common loading than mature market-driven names because vehicle-development execution is highly idiosyncratic.

annualized_sigma_meta.rationale: Milestone-driven aerospace equity path noise, used only for model-dependent drawdown.
